liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews): Listener says this version introduced many people to the band during boarding school; Listener calls Althea and Jack Straw among the best versions ever recorded [14][15][21]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the intro exactly what one looks for in a kind Scarlet; Reviewer identifies this Scarlet-Fire as their personal favorite version of the songs [13][22]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (2 reviews): Transition into Fire is described as beautifully measured and classic Dead interplay; Jerry lets drums guide the transition; performance is sultry but a warm-up [17][19]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer describes the transition to Eyes as sickness to the nth power [13]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Reviewer notes the Franklin's Tower performance is hot [23]
- Reviewer rates it one of the best Promised Land performances ever [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-10.144766.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 35 songs; 228 min [1]
- **gd1980-10-10.mtx.chappell.sb03.28740.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 33 songs; 224 min; rated 4.33/5 by 15 [3]
- **gd80-10-10.menke.vernon.13989.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 32 songs; 223 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1980-10-10.156341.akg-se5-wiseman-miller-clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 32 songs; 220 min [5]
- **gd80-10-10.sbd.cousinit.24710.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 172 min; rated 4.18/5 by 11 [8]. Said about its sound: Audience recording quality is good at the start of Minglewood, then switches to SBD; Reviewer describes the recording as a less than crisp board, not an audience [16][23]

## Around the show

- Listener claims the October 11th acoustic set is better than this one [12]
- Listener says the November 30, 1980 Fox show is significantly better than this one [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-10.144766.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5(Maxell UDXLI) [1]. Also: Nakamichi 700 first-generation source patches Ripple, Estimated Prophet, Drums, Promised Land [1]
- **gd1980-10-10.mtx.chappell.sb03.28740.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell [3]. Also: Douglas Ferguson remastered and pitch-corrected; archive user converted to SHN [3]
- **gd80-10-10.menke.vernon.13989.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; source: Audience Recording: Nakamichi CM700's [4]. Also: Bob Menke recorded from the balcony using Nakamichi CM700 mics and Sony D-5 [4]
- **gd1980-10-10.156341.akg-se5-wiseman-miller-clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [5]. Also: Scott Wiseman supplied source cassettes; Ron Ellner provided Nakamichi 700 patches for crowd and songs [5]
- **gd80-10-10.sbd.cousinit.24710.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; source: Audience Recording: Nakamichi CM700's [8]
